# Exaltis — llms.txt
# This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org)

# crawlers understand Exaltis quickly and cite it accurately.

> Exaltis is the all-in-one platform to run your limo, black car, and ground
> transportation business — dispatch, online booking, the driver app, SMS
> notifications, payments, and the affiliate network — from anywhere, at any
> time. Exaltis is provided by Uion Solutions LLC.

## About

- **Product**: Exaltis
- **Tagline**: All The Livery Software You Need
- **Provided by**: Uion Solutions LLC
- **Category**: Software as a Service · Ground Transportation Management
- **Built for**: limo operators, executive sedan, black car, airport transfer,
  and chauffeured ground transportation companies
- **Website**: https://exaltis.org
- **Free demo**: 2-hour tailored demo with a free migration plan
- **Contracts**: no long-term contracts, switch any time

## Headline numbers

- 2,500+ Operators
- 60M+ Trips dispatched
- 99.99% Platform uptime

## The six products

1. **Dispatch** — Drag-and-drop assignment, live driver locations, automated alerts,
   and a full trip lifecycle.
2. **Online Booking** — Branded reservation portal that quotes, books, and collects
   payment 24/7; embed on any website with a single snippet.
3. **3 Roles in 1 App** — One white-labeled mobile app that signs in as a rider,
   chauffeur, or back-office dispatcher.
4. **SMS Notifications** — Two-way SMS keeping riders, drivers, and dispatchers in
   sync; pickup, en-route, and arrival alerts with reply handling.
5. **Payments** — Authorize, capture, refund, and reconcile in one click. Card-on-file,
   ACH, corporate billing.
6. **Affiliate Network** — Farm work in and out across the largest verified livery
   network in the industry — without leaving Exaltis.

## Two solutions

- **Software & Payments** — Complete operating system for your business, with
  integrated card processing at industry-leading rates.
- **Affiliate Network** — Send and receive jobs across thousands of trusted
  affiliates worldwide. Verified, rated, integrated.

## Pricing

All plans require a one-time **$199.99 setup fee**. No long-term contracts.

- **Core — $129.99/month**: back-office essentials with PWA access for every role,
  unlimited drivers and dispatchers, admin-end design, 7 languages and dark/light theme.
- **Core + — $229.99/month** (Most popular): everything in Core, plus a branded public
  front-end, online booking portal, iOS & Android multi-tenant native app, affiliate
  network access, Twilio + Android SMS, email & priority support.
- **Enterprise — $399/month**: everything in Core +, plus white-labeled logo, the
  3-in-1 users app, WhatsApp phone & chat support, advanced reporting (coming soon),
  priority feature queue, 75% discounted setup fee.

## Why operators switch

- Capture more reservations with a 24/7 online booking portal.
- Save dispatcher hours — auto-assignment cuts manual coordination by up to 40%.
- Cut chargebacks with card-on-file, signature capture, and audit trails.
- Delight riders with branded apps, real-time tracking, and ETA alerts.
- Close the books faster with QuickBooks-ready exports.
- Real US-based human support, onboarding included.

## Migration

Most operators migrate in **two weekends**. Every demo includes a free migration
plan covering reservations, customers, drivers, vehicles, affiliates, and rate
structures.
